name: Shipped features
author: Brett
description: Every individual feature of AmberX-AXF and axHub in one sortable list, from the moment a build plans it to when it went live: status (Planned, Queued, Building, In PR, Merged, Live, Cancelled, Removed), the builds, PRs and commits behind it, Brett's verbatim prompt, the model and agent, and every later edit as its own timeline. A three-level grid (group, feature, details) with View by PR, build, day, app, plugin, type or repo, quick filters (hide completed, hide pending, status, has edits, being edited) remembered per device, and CSV / Markdown export. Fed live by build-hook@1 (every builds store write) and the deploy log (deploy-log@1), backfilled from git history, PRs and the builds journal. Data in SQLite (feature-ledger@1).
